The '''Iast system''' was the site of a hidden [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] research facility. The facility was known as [[To-phalion Base]], where the Imperials were trying to develop a [[Cloaking device/Legends|cloaking device]] under the codename [[Vorknkx]]. [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Demetrius Zaarin|Zaarin]] managed to infiltrate the system and steal a [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] equipped with a working [[Cloaking device/Legends|cloaking device]]. The Vorknkx research team had not yet figured out how to get the cloaking device working while a ship traveled in hyperspace though. The end result as Zaarin fled into hyperspace was the destruction of the corvette, the crew, and Zaarin.
